body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.04 (base rate n/a, class us_seasoned_5y) that: YES if the total-return multiple from 2026-11-20 (entry USD 122.89) to the last close on or before 2031-11-20 is ≤ 0.5, or the stock is delisted/suspended below that level. Model: worksheet scenarios bear 30%→0.80x, base 50%→1.16x, bull 18%→1.63x with σ=0.30; reverse DCF base-case IRR 6.8%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.12x vs hurdle 1.47x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: EST, unverified: US mid caps halving (or delisting) within 5 years ~12% (no CRSP class on file).
